title: What information extraction does · Level 2
slo: Identify what AI-powered information extraction turns into structured data.

exercises.question_text: Which parts are used in a comprehensive extraction solution? Select all that apply.

options.rationale: Computer vision detects text in image-based data. That text can then be mapped to fields.

options.text: Machine learning to map text to fields
options.rationale: Machine learning can semantically map text to fields. Mapping identifies what each value represents.

options.text: Generative AI to map text to fields
options.rationale: Generative AI can also perform semantic mapping. It can assign extracted text to meaningful fields.

options.error_type: Confuses automated extraction with manual entry
options.rationale: A comprehensive extraction solution automates text detection and field mapping. Manual review may occur, but copying every value is not the core method.
options.better_fit: Manual validation is appropriate for checking critical extracted values.

exercises.explanation: Correct. Detection is followed by semantic mapping to fields.

exercises.question_text: Labeled, organized values that business systems can store are called ___.

parts.text: Labeled, organized values that business systems can store are called

feedback_for_incorrect.intrinsic: The answer would name a process rather than the result.
feedback_for_incorrect.instructional: The required term names the labeled values produced for business use.

exercises.explanation: Structured data fields are the usable, organized output of extraction.

exercises.question_text: Arrange the parts to form a correct statement.

feedback_for_incorrect.intrinsic: The statement would not clearly describe the extension to other media.
feedback_for_incorrect.instructional: Start with the techniques, then state what they extend and the additional media.

exercises.correct_answer: Advanced techniques extend extraction beyond documents to audio and video
exercises.explanation: Advanced techniques extend information extraction from document and image inputs to additional recording media.

exercises.question_text: A claims clerk receives scanned forms and must save each employee name and address as labeled values. Which capability should the clerk choose?

options.rationale: The clerk needs scanned content turned into labeled values. AI information extraction provides that structured output.
OCR reads words from the scan but does not assign name and address meanings. The task also requires structured field assignment.
options.better_fit: OCR is appropriate when plain readable text is the only needed result.

feedback.intrinsic: The names and addresses would remain unassigned text.
feedback.instructional: The workflow needs both text reading and organization into labeled fields.

options.rationale: A template may help with a consistent layout but is not the required end-to-end capability. The clerk still needs structured values from the form.
options.better_fit: A fixed template is useful for highly standardized forms with stable field positions.

feedback.intrinsic: A layout rule would not itself produce the required labeled data.
feedback.instructional: Choose the capability that converts unstructured form content into usable fields.

options.rationale: Semantic mapping assigns already extracted text to fields. The scan still needs its text detected before mapping can occur.
options.better_fit: Semantic mapping fits a later step after text has been extracted from the forms.

feedback.intrinsic: The form text would not yet be available to map.
feedback.instructional: Choose the end-to-end capability that extracts and organizes information.

exercises.explanation: Correct. The goal is structured employee data from scanned content.

exercises.question_text: Assigning extracted text to the specific fields it represents is called ___.

parts.text: Assigning extracted text to the specific fields it represents is called

feedback_for_incorrect.intrinsic: The value could be read without receiving a useful field meaning.
feedback_for_incorrect.instructional: OCR reads visual text, while semantic mapping assigns that text to a field.

exercises.explanation: Semantic mapping connects extracted text with the data field it represents.

exercises.question_text: A support manager needs key details from recorded customer calls and video updates. Which actions should the manager include? Select all that apply.

options.text: Use speech recognition for spoken content
options.rationale: Calls and video updates contain spoken details. Speech recognition identifies those details.
Identified spoken content can supply relevant business details. Extraction turns those details into usable information.

options.text: Use advanced techniques for recording media
options.rationale: Advanced techniques support extraction from audio and video. They extend the workload beyond documents.

options.text: Treat recordings as labeled fields already
options.rationale: Recordings are unstructured input media, not finished structured data. They require recognition and extraction work first.
options.better_fit: Labeled fields are appropriate after relevant recording details have been organized.

feedback.intrinsic: The manager would skip the work needed to obtain usable details.
feedback.instructional: Identify the speech first, then extract the needed information.

exercises.explanation: Correct. Recording content must be identified and extracted before it becomes usable.

feedback_for_incorrect.intrinsic: The claim would attempt to use values before they were available.
feedback_for_incorrect.instructional: Follow the dependency from receipt text to identified values to mapped claim fields.

exercises.correct_answer: Extract receipt text identify relevant values map values to claim fields
exercises.explanation: Text must be extracted before relevant values can be identified and mapped to fields.

exercises.question_text: A photograph of a business card can be used to read ___.

parts.text: A photograph of a business card can be used to read

feedback_for_incorrect.intrinsic: The card's intended details would not be captured.
feedback_for_incorrect.instructional: Associate business cards with contact information, not financial or legal records.

exercises.explanation: Business-card extraction is a simple use for obtaining contact information.

exercises.question_text: An employee uploads a receipt for reimbursement. To reduce manual entry while preparing the claim, which actions should the solution perform? Select all that apply.

options.rationale: The receipt's text must be read before details can be used. This starts the extraction workflow.
Only some receipt values are needed for the reimbursement claim. Identification separates those values from other content.
Mapping places identified values into the fields they represent. This makes the values usable for claim preparation.

options.text: Use the receipt only as an image
options.rationale: Storing only an image does not reduce manual entry. The solution must read and organize receipt values.
options.better_fit: Image-only storage is appropriate when no claim details need to be extracted.

feedback.intrinsic: The specialist would still need to enter reimbursement details manually.
feedback.instructional: Read the receipt, identify the necessary values, and map them to claim fields.

exercises.explanation: Correct. These steps turn receipt content into usable claim data.

exercises.question_text: Arrange the parts to form the correct statement.

feedback_for_incorrect.intrinsic: The definition would not clearly show what is combined or why.
feedback_for_incorrect.instructional: Name the workload first, then the techniques and their purpose.

exercises.correct_answer: Information extraction combines multiple AI techniques to extract data from content
exercises.explanation: The workload combines techniques for the purpose of extracting data from content.

exercises.question_text: An expense-claim processor has read “45.00” from a receipt image and must decide whether to save it in the Total field. Which step makes that decision?

options.rationale: The value has already been read from the image. Semantic mapping determines whether it represents the Total field.
OCR reads visual characters such as 45.00. It does not decide that the value belongs in Total.
options.better_fit: OCR is appropriate when the receipt characters first need to become text.

feedback.intrinsic: The number would be available but could remain unassigned.
feedback.instructional: Use OCR to read the characters and semantic mapping to determine the field.

options.rationale: Image acquisition obtains the receipt image for processing. It does not interpret a value that has already been read.
options.better_fit: Image acquisition is appropriate when the receipt photo first enters the system.

feedback.intrinsic: The receipt would be captured but its total would not be identified.
feedback.instructional: Capturing comes first; semantic mapping decides the value's field meaning.

options.rationale: Quality validation reviews an existing result for errors or exceptions. It does not decide the field meaning of a newly read value.
options.better_fit: Quality validation fits a later review of a value already mapped to Total.

feedback.intrinsic: The value could be reviewed without ever being assigned to Total.
feedback.instructional: Assign the value through semantic mapping before validating the result.

exercises.explanation: Correct. Semantic mapping makes the field decision.

exercises.question_text: An operations manager receives many digital shipping documents and wants to automate follow-up work. Which benefits can an information extraction workload provide? Select all that apply.

options.rationale: The workload extracts usable values from document content. Shipping records can contain details needed for follow-up.
The workload uses multiple techniques together. This supports obtaining usable data from documents.
Extracted values can support automated follow-up actions. This is a key benefit of the workload.
Extraction requires identifying useful data within content. Avoiding interpretation leaves needed shipping details unavailable.
options.better_fit: Avoiding interpretation can fit simple archival storage of files.

feedback.intrinsic: The shipping details would remain buried in the documents.
feedback.instructional: The workload extracts and organizes document information so automation can use it.

exercises.explanation: Correct. Extraction produces data that can support automated work.
